title: The journal's reader reads past entry kinds it does not know
situation: The architect restated the concepts as name and differentia and cut implementation from them; this behaviour, which the concepts carried before, is recorded here so it stays bound.
decision: A reading of the concept journal reads past every entry, and every value of a known kind, that this runtime does not know, works out its answer from the rest, and reports what it read past and that the answer may be incomplete; it never refuses the whole journal for them. Appending still works on such a journal, and no entry is rewritten or removed.
consequences: An older runtime reads a journal a newer one wrote; the report says what it could not interpret.
